📋 Employee Data Source

Import an Excel or CSV file once. Shared by Exam, ID Generator, and Logbooks — search once, use everywhere.

Drop Excel/CSV with columns: Position, Full Name, Email Address, Start Date, Badge, Screen Name, Phone Number, Shift Preference, Team Name, Workday ID, Barcode, Status, Gender, Game Knowledge, Languages, Team Manager, Set. Game presenters (VIP, Premium, Beginner) must have a Screen Name, Workday ID and Barcode. For shufflers, shift leads, managers, seniors and coordinators these are optional. Every row needs a name. Only Status = Employed or Probation employees appear in searches.
⏱ Scheduled import from Google Drive (admin)
Put the Workday report (CSV, Excel or Google Sheet) in one Drive folder, for example with a Workday scheduled export. The tool takes the newest file in that folder. It uses the same Google script as the email setup (Admin panel, 📧 section). The Excel import above keeps working as before.
Automatic checks run only while the tool is open on the admin device. An automatic import never asks questions, and it stops without changing anything if the file would remove more than 20% of the people. Rows with a missing important field are skipped and reported, as with Excel.

Finished trainees:
⬆ Upload Excel file (.xlsx / .xlsm) or CSV — click here or drag & drop it. The tool reads the Information sheet (or the “Paste here” block) and fills in every trainee: names, IDs, contacts, team, shift, experience, attendance and status.
Ready Excel-like: Ctrl+C/V · Del · Ctrl+Z · double-click resize · sticky header
Selection: click a row number to select a row, a column header to select a column (Shift = extend, Ctrl = add another); Ctrl+A / corner = all. Delete key clears the selected cells; Delete row(s) / Delete column(s) (or right-click) remove them; Ctrl+Z undoes a deletion. Blue italic cells are calculated. Click a cell, type to edit, arrows / Tab / Enter to move, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V for ranges (copies as plain tab-separated text, so it pastes cleanly into Excel). Click a column header to select the whole column. Drag the small square at the corner of a selection, or press Ctrl+D / Ctrl+R, to fill. Drag header edges to resize columns (double-click resets).

Signatures & descriptions

Logbooks

Logbooks are independent of Exam. Add any game, save a description trainees must read, select employees, and print a signature sheet — no Word files required. Games that also exist in Exam can still hand off after an evaluation.

Games & descriptions

Logbook games are independent of Exam. Built-in and custom logbooks appear here; Exam games are included when available. A game needs only a description to print — no checklist required.
